description: This file defines the Bloodhound class, a component of the typeahead.js library used for managing and searching datasets for autocomplete functionality.

classes.name: Bloodhound
classes.description: A class for managing datasets and performing searches for typeahead/autocomplete features.

methods.name: noConflict
methods.description: Restores previous window.Bloodhound if it exists and returns the Bloodhound class.

methods.name: ttAdapter
methods.description: Deprecated method for jQuery plugin integration, calls __ttAdapter.

methods.name: _loadPrefetch
methods.description: Loads prefetch data, either from cache or network, and updates the index.

methods.name: _initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Bloodhound instance, including prefetch loading and adding local data.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Public method to initialize or reinitialize the dataset.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search query, optionally fetching remote data if needed.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns all data in the index.
